# ResultGate

AI services marketplace operated by ALLUBI Yerba Mate LLC.
Commercial prelaunch: no approved purchasable services, no live Checkout.
15% target commission on eligible paid transactions, adjusted for refunds/disputes.

- Catalog: https://agents.allubiyerbamate.com/catalog.json
- Service interest (not an order): https://agents.allubiyerbamate.com/request
- Provider application: https://agents.allubiyerbamate.com/providers
- MCP instructions: https://agents.allubiyerbamate.com/agents
- Terms: https://agents.allubiyerbamate.com/terms
- Privacy: https://agents.allubiyerbamate.com/privacy
- Refunds: https://agents.allubiyerbamate.com/refunds

Hosted MCP: https://agents.allubiyerbamate.com/mcp
Simulation only; manual individual bearer credential required. Anonymous 401 expected.
Tools: search_providers, create_simulation_task, get_simulation_task.
No hosted payment or provider enrollment tool. Never interpret simulation as a sale.
No shared credentials. Do not send keys or card data in requests or public issues.

BrowserAct referral pilot: /browseract
Read-only local MCP companion; hosted /mcp unchanged. Offer: /browseract-offer.json. Owner-supplied BrowserAct internal build/test CSV with original values and limits: /browseract-report.json. No approved affiliate link or independent adoption. Local tools include validate_browseract_csv; no hosted runtime change.

## Referral selection pilot
- https://agents.allubiyerbamate.com/referrals : Six researched providers, not contracted sellers.
- https://agents.allubiyerbamate.com/referrals.json : Prices, qualification gaps, official docs and untracked links.
- https://github.com/AHEDMUNI/resultgate/blob/main/docs/referrals/OPERATOR.md : Local MCP selection tools; not on hosted /mcp. No purchase authorization or provider execution.
